text:
maya: Heads up — noticed ~$18.45k in credits stuck in 'escrow' for account redwood-gpu-reserve-1. They're not applying to this month's Dedicated invoice. Anyone else seeing this? cc @devin

devin: Looking now. Are these contract credits or promotional grants?

maya: Contract credits from our 2024 commit. Billing dashboard shows escrowed: true and escrow_reason empty in UI.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-78321 (2026-03-05): credits flagged as ESCROW until 'contract_confirmation' event.

priya: This is blocking capacity reallocation for ap-southeast pools — finance won't reassign until credits clear. Ops needs ETA. :grimacing:

devin: Running export to verify allocation. Query: `SELECT id, amount, created_at, status, escrow_reason FROM credits WHERE account = 'redwood-gpu-reserve-1' AND status = 'escrow';`

devin: Query result: amount=18450 USD, created_at=2024-11-30, source='commit-2024-Q4', escrow_reason='missing_signoff'

sam: Missing signoff? I thought PO ingestion auto-signed. @eli anything in the webhook logs from that period?

eli: I see the PO webhook to billing-service had a 504 spike on 2024-12-01. Retries happened but idempotency keys were inconsistent for a subset, so billing treated them as partial and moved to escrow.

devin: If we flip escrow -> appliable, the invoice system will apply to reserved charges. Need legal signoff record or a manual override with audit note.

maya: Can finance do a manual override to apply it to March invoice? Our Dedicated commit for ap-southeast is being throttled otherwise.

devin: We can do a one-off release but require: (1) PO id, (2) proof of service, (3) ops approval in thread.

priya: PO id: PO-44321. Proof: deployment assignments and capacity logs (I can attach). Ops approves applying to INV-78321. :white_check_mark:

devin: Creating a release ticket now. Draft audit note: "Release escrowed commit credits PO-44321 to apply to invoice INV-78321; reason: webhook failure on 2024-12-01; ops approved." Tagging legal for records.

legal: Please include the original contract clause referencing committed credits and confirm service delivery within the agreed timeframe.

maya: Uploaded proof: /finance-drive/PO-44321/deployments/ap-southeast/2024-12-02.log (contains assignment entries, timestamps).

billing-bot: Action logged: credit_release_request by devin at 1918765800.

devin: Manual release executed. Invoice INV-78321 now shows credits applied: -18,450 USD. Will confirm the payment run and update ledger.

sam: Nice. Can we add a small automation so future webhook retries keep the original idempotency key derived from PO ingestion? That should prevent this class of escrow.

eli: Good call. I'll patch the webhook handler to derive idempotency from a deterministic PO hash and add a nightly reconciliation that moves credits out of escrow after 48h if the contract and PO are present (with emailed warnings).

priya: For capacity planning: mark those credits as 'applied' in the Dedicated capacity planner so we can ramp ap-southeast pools back up.

maya: Thanks team. If anyone finds other escrowed commits, ping #finance and drop PO ids here so we can batch releases. :pray:
